purpose: Test whether semantic retrieval can run without an always-on project server while preserving the frozen full-index retrieval behavior closely enough for a later opt-in production experiment.

fixed_design.prototype_sample_method: uniform deterministic vector-id stride over the frozen corpus
fixed_design.document_quantization: symmetric signed int8 with fixed scale 127 after L2 normalization
fixed_design.cluster_training_method: uniform deterministic vector-id stride over the frozen corpus

decision_rule.pass: Every applicable gate passes without changing the fixed design.
decision_rule.fail: Any applicable gate fails. Stop this version without tuning; a changed configuration requires a separately frozen v2 preregistration.
decision_rule.continuation_if_pass: Build immutable full-corpus static shards and metadata, validate hashes and browser retrieval, then prepare a separate default-off production integration proposal.
decision_rule.continuation_if_fail: Keep the current server-backed semantic alpha and the automatic traditional-search fallback unchanged.

prohibitions: No production changes in this experiment.
No changes to src/core/rank.js or the existing retrieval pipeline.
No human relevance labels during construction or inference.
No model weights committed to Git.
No modification of frozen FAISS, embeddings or prior benchmark artifacts.
No post-hoc parameter tuning within v1.
